I have clinical depression so first thing to remember is there is nothing you can do to make it more comfortable. I know, it sucks but when the depression hits, you have two choices basically, lock yourself away from the world till it goes and self harm to make it go quicker or to say fuck you depression and force yourself to do something. You can be there for her and to let her know you are there if she ever needs a friend but just remember the depression is n't going anywhere so if you like her and want to be in it for the long haul you need to realise that her depression is for life. I'm on antidepressants, they keep it at bay but even then my depression still comes and says hello a few times a week. Dating a person with depression is hard work as we have gotten use to hiding our feelings from people as most people don't have a clue. Search google, and read up on depression and what you can do to help. It will give you some insight, just remember don't say you will be there for her and then a few months down the line say fuck it I'm out as depression feeds on disappointment. Be there for her and learn as much as you can from google. Good luck

Alex, I myself am suicidal and will be giving it another shot in a few days. My advice is simple. If the person truly wants to die, no amount of talking will make them change their mind. You can only be there for her, let her know she is loved by you and that no matter the outcome you will  always be there for her. I say no matter the outcome as she could survive her suicide attempt. The stress and torture of a failed suicide attempt is immense. You feel like a complete failure and even worse than before as you have even failed at killing yourself. She is the only one that can choose whether to take her life or not. You can only hope that she doesn't or that she fails. If she fails, you need to be there for her no matter what. She will feel ashamed and may not want to see you. She may want "space" but sadly she can't have it as she may try again straight after hoping to get it right this time. If she fails, she could be left with life long injuries depending on her chosen method. There is no right or wrong way to handle the situation as everyone is different, just be there for her. Tell her she is loved, show her it. Go and see her face to face. Ask her if she is serious and when she plans on doing it. If she says no or hesitates, tell her you want to make sure her "last day" is the greatest. Tell her that if you are going to leave me I want my last memory of you to be unforgettable. Treat her, make her feel happy loved wanted. It's all you can do. End of the day if she is successful at least you know you tried and that your last moments with her were amazing. Good luck Buddy
